# Generated by Omen Build System
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ExampleGame CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Module: CoreModule
add_library(CoreModule SHARED
    Source/Core/Private/Core.cpp
)

target_include_directories(CoreModule PUBLIC
    Source/Core
    Source/Core/Public
)
target_include_directories(CoreModule PRIVATE
    Source/Core/Private
)
target_compile_definitions(CoreModule
    PUBLIC CORE_API=__declspec(dllexport)
    PUBLIC PLATFORM_WINDOWS=1
    PUBLIC _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
)

# Module: EngineModule

    Source/Engine/Private/Engine.cpp
)

)

    Source/Engine/Private
)
target_compile_definitions(EngineModule
    PUBLIC ENGINE_API=__declspec(dllexport)
)
target_link_libraries(EngineModule PUBLIC
    CoreModule
)
